description: Read-only FreeStyle glucose sensor access via LibreLinkUp. Not a medical device.
name: io.github.lozit/mcp-freestyle

environmentVariables.description: LibreLinkUp *follower* account e-mail — not the primary LibreLink account. The password is stored once via `npx mcp-freestyle-login` in the OS keychain, so it never appears in this configuration.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRELINKUP_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the OS keychain. Intended for CI and one-off runs; prefer `mcp-freestyle-login` so no credential lands in a config file.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRELINKUP_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Pinned LibreLinkUp client version sent as the `version` header. Upstream rejects stale values — set this to the current LibreLinkUp app version if requests start failing.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRELINKUP_VERSION

environmentVariables.description: Client product identifier sent as the `product` header.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRELINKUP_PRODUCT

environmentVariables.description: Entry point for authentication. The regional host is discovered at login and is never configured here.
environmentVariables.name: LIBRELINKUP_BASE_URL
